# Fix The System, Not Just The Ticket

Use this skill when the local fix is necessary but clearly insufficient.

## Trigger conditions

- the same bug class appears repeatedly
- the same review comments recur
- architecture violations repeat
- docs, tests, or validation are repeatedly missing
- tasks fail because context or tooling keeps being absent

## Expected response

- fix the current issue
- identify the root systemic gap
- add the smallest durable improvement that reduces recurrence

## Typical systemic improvements

- better docs or plans
- lint or structural checks
- templates or generated helpers
- examples or runbooks
- validation or test coverage

## Output

- current fix
- root cause
- systemic gap
- durable improvement added now
- deferred follow-up if the larger fix is postponed
